defs.def: to touch sb with your lips as a sign of love, affection, sexual desire, etc., or when saying hello or goodbye 亲吻；接吻

ex.s: She looked well and happy but as I kissed her lips, they became pale, as if she were dead.
ex.t: 她看起来安好快乐，但当我亲吻她的嘴唇时，它们变得苍白，仿佛她已经死了。

ex.s: Then she sits in Oliver’s lap, puts her arms around his neck and kisses him on the cheek.
ex.t: 然后她坐在奥利弗的腿上，搂住他的脖子，亲吻了他的脸颊。

ex.s: In countries like France and Russia, people may kiss their friends on the cheek when they meet.
ex.t: 在法国和俄罗斯等国家，人们在见面时可能亲吻朋友的脸颊。

ex.s: Aspects of body language Kissing People in Spain, Italy and France tend to greet others by kissing Though people in Europe prefer having more personal space, there is more and kissing.
ex.t: 肢体语言方面：亲吻。西班牙、意大利和法国的人倾向于通过亲吻来问候。虽然欧洲人更喜欢拥有更多的个人空间，但也有越来越多人亲吻。

defs.def: to gently move or touch sth 轻拂；轻触
